steps.title: Define App Specifications and Metadata
steps.description: Establish the Smart Notes app metadata, configuring parameters such as app name and package name in app-meta.json.

steps.title: Create AndroidManifest for Smart Notes
steps.description: Construct the main configuration manifest declaring MainActivity, NoteActivity, and the application theme with strict schema definitions.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Properties
steps.description: Establish target compatibility with Java 8, configure AGP version 8.3.2, compile SDK 34, and setup project gradle repositories.

steps.title: Define Style Resources and Colors
steps.description: Define consistent Material color attributes and localized app values to present a polished visual palette.

steps.title: Create Card and Badge Drawable Backgrounds
steps.description: Author custom shape resources in XML to create rounded corners, custom strokes, and container widgets.

steps.title: Create Rounded and Colored Button Backgrounds
steps.description: Construct colored states and rounded corner structures for action buttons, edit triggers, and deletion tools.

steps.title: Design Main Activity Layout
steps.description: Structure XML coordinates including the search bar input, note filter dropdown spinner, note list view, and floating action button.

steps.title: Design Note Editor Layout
steps.description: Incorporate high-quality text editor fields for capturing the note's header, category type, detailed paragraphs, and saving options.

steps.title: Create Note ListItem Adapter Layout
steps.description: Coordinate the visual hierarchy for individual list rows representing note title, category pills, truncated summary, and insertion date.

steps.title: Implement SQLite Database Engine
steps.description: Develop NoteDbHelper subclass extending standard SQLiteOpenHelper to maintain reliable SQL database tables and default initial entries.

steps.title: Define Note Data Class Structure
steps.description: Implement structural object parameters for Notes containing id, title, content, category, and date parameters.

steps.title: Develop Main Note Handler Logics
steps.description: Compose the core logic in MainActivity to handle DB queries, run filtering logic, intercept real-time search strings, and refresh views.

steps.title: Implement Editor and Operations Controller
steps.description: Build NoteActivity code to manage creation, loading existing note payloads, editing strings, SQLite modifications, and validation toasts.

steps.title: Finalize Manifest Declarations
steps.description: Assure exact activity launch properties, screen input modifications, and package designations.

steps.title: Building Smart Notes
steps.description: Assemble files and compile debug APK with Gradle using pure Android SDK configurations.
